candidates.description: This vector activates on German indefinite pronouns and determiners expressing totality or specificity, such as "jeder," "jede," and "jemand."
German modal and auxiliary verbs expressing necessity, possibility, and past action.
This vector activates on common German intensifying and qualifying adverbs and indefinite pronouns used to modify verbs, adjectives, or clauses.
This vector represents German subordinating conjunctions and introductory particles used to form dependent clauses.
This vector represents competitive sporting events and tournaments.
This vector represents the German preposition and verbal prefix "auf" along with phonetically or orthographically similar English and German word fragments.
This vector represents the German letter 'ä' and its common tokenizations and morphological suffixes.
This vector is activated by words starting with the letter 'B' or the sound /b/.
This feature vector represents standard, canonical, or conforming structural patterns and attributes.
This feature vector activates strongly on common German nominal and verbal prefixes starting with the letter 'G'.
